  run() {
    let total = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3 ; ++i) {
      total += i;
    }
    if (total === 3) {
        print('ok');
    } else {
        print('no');
    }

    let xs = [1, 2, 3];
    for (const x of xs) {
      print(x);
    }
  }

}
